_comment: TiinyMesh - an example config.
Copy this, edit it, and point the gateway at it:
TIINY_MESH_CONFIG=./config.json python3 gateway.py
A TARGET is one of four things: an id, a base URL, an optional
credential, and a kind. The kind decides what else it has.
kind: tiiny     an appliance. Its catalogue comes from the STORE
(GET /api/v1/models/online_models), not /v1/models,
because /v1/models lists only what is resident.
Has a lifecycle: download / start / stop.
kind: openai    anything speaking OpenAI /v1. No lifecycle.
kind: anthropic  an Anthropic-style API.
FIELDS
base_url     the OpenAI-compatible root every target speaks to.
admin_url    the device admin root, for an appliance only.
key_env      the NAME of an env var holding the credential. The
value is never written here - it is read from the
environment at call time. Omit it for a target that
needs no credential.
priority     lower wins when a bare model id is served by more than
one target.
capabilities what this target can do at all. Used for routing a
request that did not name a model.
keep_resident models to re-load after the appliance reboots. A Tiiny
unloads everything on reboot. Only declare this for a
box whose loads are unattended.
extra_body   merged into every request to this target. The Tiiny
boxes and OGAD need thinking off or they spend the
whole token budget on reasoning.
boot         the command that starts a stopped local server.
models       an explicit model list, for a cloud target.
DEFAULTS - capability -> the mesh_id that serves it when the caller
does not name a model.
embedding  the tier with no NPU cost and the biggest dimension
tts        speech synthesis
asr        transcription
image_gen  image generation
chat       the default chat model
The embedding dimension is part of the contract: a RAG index built
against 1024-dim vectors breaks silently if the route shifts to a
384-dim model. Every embedding response carries its dimension.
